mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is in the lowest tercile of its historical range.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals a weakening labor market and impending economic slowdown, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has a negative Rank IC over any 12-month rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 40% of interaction signal instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime defined by declining industrial production, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as firms face higher input costs and reduced output, over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines in the last month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate signals strong economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 growth is above the historical mean.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls and decrease in unemployment rate signals a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * (1/UNRATE)) has a negative Rank IC over any 12-month rolling window, or positive returns occur in less than 40% of interaction signal instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp over 3 months.
